digest.component_or_area: CI workflows and Git partial clone infrastructure
propositions: CI tickets-branch fetches must apply blob:none partial clone filter to reduce transfer cost from multi-gigabyte full checkouts to sub-100 MiB blobless packs
actions/checkout@v7 steps in reconcile-bridge, verify-identity, and reconcile-bridge-canary workflows must preserve fetch-depth: 0 and existing credentials while adding filter: blob:none input
Gerrit gerrit-verify.yaml direct URL fetches require explicit --filter=blob:none flag: depth-1 for require-ticket and full-history (no depth) for verify-identity
Production guards must parse git count-objects -v size-pack output and enforce limits: standalone checkout at 102400 KiB and Gerrit materialized at 131072 KiB, immediately rejecting oversized packs
Real-Git protocol tests must verify filter capability advertisement, client-side filter blob:none packet transmission, and missing-blob state using git daemon with GIT_TRACE_PACKET inspection
Materialized identity scans must produce byte-identical git count-objects -v snapshots before and after verify-identity execution, proving no promisor object fetches during scanning
